content.title: Content preferences

channel.inAppHint: The inbox and the unread badge. Off stops everything below it.

kind.sourceAdded: A new source to read on

update.title: Updates

unmanaged.package: This copy was installed from the .deb package, so your package manager owns its files. New releases are announced here but installed by apt.
unmanaged.portable: This copy runs from a portable archive, so there is no install to upgrade. Replace the folder with the new archive.

closing.hint: The window disappears when you close it, but the app keeps running, so chapter notifications still arrive. Open it again from the tray icon — which is also where you quit for good.

window.unsupported: This system offers neither a sign-in list nor a tray, so there is nothing to set here.

adapterTest.hint: Runs the adapter against the live site (latest list, and optionally one series path).

deleteRadius.one: Deletes 1 series with every chapter, source, watchlist entry and reading position attached to it. A re-scan restores the chapters; nothing restores the reading positions.
deleteRadius.other: Deletes {count} series with every chapter, source, watchlist entry and reading position attached to them. A re-scan restores the chapters; nothing restores the reading positions.

catalogue.deleted: Deleted {series} series, {chapters} chapters and {watchers} watchlist entries.
catalogue.intro: Everything the scanners have collected. Tick rows to delete them in bulk, or empty the catalogue outright from the danger zone below.
catalogue.purgeAllWhy: Removes all {series} series, {chapters} chapters, {watchers} watchlist entries and {progress} reading positions. Providers, users and accounts survive. This runs in batches and can be resumed if it is interrupted.
catalogue.purgeChaptersWhy: Removes all {chapters} chapters. Series and their provider sources survive, so the next full scan refills them.
catalogue.purgeStalled: The purge stopped making progress and was halted. Check the server logs before running it again.
catalogue.selectPage: Select every series on this page
catalogue.title: Catalogue

decisions.flagged: Flagged wrong. The pair will not be merged again.
decisions.flaggedAndBlocked: Flagged wrong, and this match will not be made again.
decisions.intro: Why the duplicate sweep merged what it merged, and why the sync engine wrote what it wrote. Every row carries the itemised score behind it, the rule that decided it, and — where the action can be taken back — an undo.
decisions.noTerms: No itemised score was recorded for this decision.

reason.both_sides_changed_newest_is_local: both changed, your side was touched last
reason.both_sides_changed_newest_is_remote: both changed, the tracker was touched last
reason.both_sides_changed_policy_local_wins: both changed, your side wins by policy
reason.both_sides_changed_policy_remote_wins: both changed, the tracker wins by policy
reason.both_sides_changed_queued_for_the_reader: both changed, left for you to settle
reason.both_sides_converged: both sides reached the same value
reason.no_ancestor_agreement: first sync, both sides already agreed
reason.no_ancestor_newest_is_local: first sync, your side was touched last
reason.no_ancestor_newest_is_remote: first sync, the tracker was touched last
reason.no_ancestor_policy_local_wins: first sync, your side wins by policy
reason.no_ancestor_policy_remote_wins: first sync, the tracker wins by policy
reason.no_ancestor_queued_for_the_reader: first sync, disagreement left for you to settle
reason.no_candidates: nothing in the catalogue to match against
reason.no_remote_media_found: no matching entry on the tracker
reason.no_structural_identity: similar, but not the same string
reason.series_already_reconciled_this_run: the tracker listed this work twice
reason.structural_identity_above_threshold: identical titles above the automatic threshold

decisions.reasonRequired: Give a reason: this judgement is durable and will be read without you.
decisions.reverted: Merge undone: {rows} rows restored, and the pair will not be merged again.
decisions.searchEmpty: No decision among the loaded rows matches that search.
decisions.title: Automatic decisions

live.staleClaim: Oldest task has been held for {duration} — a worker may be stuck.

explain.noStages: No stage timings recorded for this run yet.
explain.unmeasured: No task has recorded a breakdown yet — come back once one settles.
explain.trivial: Too little work measured so far to say anything useful.

explain.fetching: {percent}% of the time was spent inside {requests} requests — the provider is answering slowly.
explain.stage: Most of the time went into {stage} ({percent}%).
explain.mixed: No single stage dominates; the time is spread across the run.
